book.title: Luka Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Lukaꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iesuꞌa Kuru Ihoziro
Mada ꞌahogano Iesuꞌe haba ꞌahogano kurau radiro. Kuru hauḡirotene, ane tahiꞌa ꞌahoganiꞌa niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, Ioane Babatisoꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa kuru ihoziroteꞌe teige, emeḡe zuni kuru ihofoꞌi.”
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Zaꞌe kuranoꞌidene, ꞌahige kuranoꞌi:

content.text: eme umiꞌeꞌohe, ḡae niꞌe zaḡoḡa reꞌuma,
Mada niduꞌa emeḡeꞌa atiteꞌe ogomuḡa rifiꞌenoꞌi,
ebu emeꞌa emeḡe mazao sauꞌa haḡairoteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa haḡaize sauꞌa rae modeꞌeteꞌe teige,
Ebu eme haḡai sauꞌa haḡaihi raꞌeteꞌe zamaroneḡanonoꞌo mae tutufe vaḡifoꞌi.'”

content: Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Hari idaidaḡa ꞌahi zamaroꞌi. Zae boꞌaḡano vaze ꞌahogaꞌe nabudiḡeta. Ohe nema ꞌahogano nabuganiꞌa ane vaze ne onamadu uminiro, 'Eḡe vaze, ꞌuvahu odoga uḡidu enoꞌi,
mazaḡa eḡe vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ragaveꞌeteꞌea iziduꞌu eḡe vaḡe areha, rehano e hatiteꞌe ogomuḡa oꞌoꞌa.'

Ebu ne vazeḡaniꞌa naenaeniro, 'Zamahe ago adudunoꞌi. Ibiheta ꞌai bireha, ebu e eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa teite bazeꞌe ꞌahine, iḡunadu ḡau ꞌahoga ḡanogaꞌe mene idaḡa.'” Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ḡadiziro, “Za zuni ꞌouge naenaeniꞌumahe?
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, aniꞌe nabuga veize daꞌoꞌe iḡunadu ꞌuvahu odoga mene haꞌuma, rehano nabuganiꞌa barebare umineꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, iḡunadu umideꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa haꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, uminoꞌi, ꞌougine ziniꞌuma. Vaḡoꞌi, ꞌougine horoniꞌuma. Ibiheta toketokeroꞌi, ꞌougine ibiheta vavaoziniꞌuma.
Umineꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa ziniꞌuma, vaḡeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa horoniꞌuma, ebu ibiheta toketokereꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa ibiheta vavaoziniꞌuma.
Zae boꞌaḡano iniu ubuganiꞌa ḡozone umidine, moganiꞌa ḡozone mene hanadu mohe haꞌumahe?
Ebu ubuganiꞌa kokoroku maḡa umidine, moganiꞌa asiasi haꞌumahe?
Zaꞌe sauꞌa azaḡa rehano, ḡahunone manoḡa ubudeze zenoga urateꞌohe. Eꞌe teige, zae Moze adureo radiuꞌetaꞌaꞌe ane mazao umideꞌeteꞌe azaḡa hube hune Vine Zaḡoḡa ziniꞌuma.”
Iesu zu Belezebulo
Mada ꞌahogano Iesuꞌa mumutafa vazeḡa ꞌahoga mazaonoꞌo vine sauꞌa hegone buniro. Vine sauꞌaniꞌa ani mode buarotene, mumutafa vazeḡaniꞌa bare ḡoeriro ebu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa zaguzagaro.
Rehano vaze nuꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, “Iesuꞌa vine sauꞌasauꞌa zuhiꞌaḡa, Belezebulo inaraḡa hina vine sauꞌasauꞌa hegoze buzeꞌohe.”
U nuꞌe Iesu tuhune nurihi radu uminiro, “Badiꞌa gigiꞌaḡa hina haḡai nu badeḡa haḡaoꞌi.”

Rehano Iesuꞌa ze nouge rae zamarirotaꞌaꞌe ederadu ziro, “Haba tiba zamaḡano zeḡeꞌa rovotadu utitine, eꞌe habaꞌaꞌe aneꞌa bare ruiniꞌuma. Ebu ne tiba zamaḡano zeḡeꞌa rovotadu utitine, ne eꞌe aneꞌa bare higaꞌuma.

Sataniꞌe aneꞌa bare rovonadu ane zamaḡano utitine, aneꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe habaꞌaꞌe nougenouge edau gigaraꞌuma? Zaꞌe eḡeꞌa Belezebulo inaraḡa hina vine sauꞌa hegone buneꞌohe rae raꞌohe, rehano ꞌougine ani aneꞌa bare ruiniꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa Belezebulo inaraḡa hina vine sauꞌa hegoze buzifone, zae tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe iniu inara hina vine sauꞌa hegoze buzifo? Zae tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe zeḡeꞌa bare zaꞌe veꞌoḡa rae reꞌuma.
Rehano eḡeꞌa vine sauꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa inaraḡa hina hegoze buzine, Badiꞌaꞌa amahi zae zuhiꞌazi radiuꞌohe.
Inara vazeḡaniꞌa uti ḡauḡa nunu hina neḡa taufine, ḡauḡa niduꞌaꞌe manoḡa radiꞌuma.

Rehano inara ufeta boro vazeḡaniꞌa arine, inara vazeḡa utite raharahaniꞌuma. Inara vazeḡaꞌe uti ḡauḡaniꞌa ani biriꞌuma rae zamariꞌuma. Rehano inara ufeta boro vazeḡaniꞌa inara vazeḡa uti ḡauḡa meiniꞌuma ebu ani ne ḡau niduꞌa zuni meinadu ḡahuge ḡuzuhiꞌuma.
Iniu eḡe teite mene reine, aniꞌe eḡe agirohiꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa. Ebu iniu eḡe teite Badiꞌa veize vaze mene nuꞌozine, ani Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo vaze rovozeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa.”
Vine Sauꞌaniꞌa Bariro

Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Vine sauꞌa ꞌahoganiꞌa vaze ꞌahoga mazaonoꞌo buauꞌetene, ahiꞌa ohonoga radu vu oꞌoꞌa habaꞌa vaḡe ragaveꞌohe. Rehano mene horoneꞌetene, ani ꞌahige rae raꞌohe, 'Eḡeꞌa ibite radiroteꞌe neḡa bare onamihi.'
Ebu ani baradu vaze eꞌe horoneꞌetene, aniꞌe neḡa deheḡa hune zu idaidane touga heuḡa.
Ebu vine sauꞌa eꞌeꞌa onamadu vine sauꞌa niduꞌa fuꞌo aheu fare, ufeta hune sauꞌa zamaze areꞌohe, ebu ze vaze eꞌe zamaḡano diuḡe radiuꞌohe. ꞌOugadu vaze eꞌeꞌa mada ibiꞌa vitine ufeta sautuꞌohe.”
Matuꞌu Huga
Iesuꞌa ḡoere eꞌe raꞌeteꞌea, vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa boꞌaḡano roḡae ꞌahoganiꞌa agoḡa boro hina Iesu niro, “Ḡa fureꞌiroteꞌe zu ḡubuꞌe borofiroteꞌe roḡaeḡaniꞌa matuꞌe rudauꞌohe!”
Rehano Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Badiꞌa ḡoere egohauꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa matuꞌe rudauꞌohe.”
Iona Haḡai Nu Badeḡa
Iesu vaḡe ariroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ufeta ḡehararotene, Iesuꞌa ziro, “Izidi egaꞌe sauꞌa, ebu ze haḡai nu badeḡa umideꞌohe. Rehano Iona mazao fureraroteꞌe haḡai nu badeḡa daꞌo furenoziniꞌuma.
Iona mazao naginiꞌa furerarotaꞌaꞌe Nineva azaḡa mazao haḡai nu badeḡa reiro. Eꞌe teige, Vaze Ubuga mazao naginiꞌa fureratitaꞌaꞌe izidi ega mazao haḡai nu badeḡa reꞌuma.

Badiꞌa kota madaḡano Siba habaꞌa kini roḡaeḡaniꞌa izidi ega azaḡa teite iḡune edanadu zeꞌe veꞌoḡa rae roziꞌuma. Mazaḡa ibite madaḡano Siba habaꞌa kini roḡaeḡaniꞌa haba ḡonaga faḡa huneonoꞌo kini Solomona zamarone huhuzaḡa abitoga veize onamiro. U izidi Solomona vitinoga vazeḡaꞌe ꞌahi eꞌe, rehano ze ane ḡoere abitoga mene urateꞌohe.

Badiꞌa kota madaḡano Nineva azaḡaniꞌa izidi ega azaḡa teite iḡune edanadu zeꞌe veꞌoḡa rae roziꞌuma. Mazaḡa ibite madaḡano Nineva azaḡaꞌe Iona haramo abitadu haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo ḡihure ḡouriro. Izidi Iona vitinoga vazeḡaꞌe ꞌahi eꞌe, rehano ze ane ḡoere mene abitadu mene ḡihureꞌohe.”
Ahiri Agaḡa
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ihure hofadu mene ꞌuꞌuru tiꞌe ga siuva hina mene ogone tiꞌohe. Rehano ne diuḡeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa agaḡa horonoga veize ihure odaḡa rana tiꞌohe.
Zae ubumaꞌe ahirize ihureḡa. Ubumazeꞌe manoḡa reine, ahirizeꞌe agaḡaniꞌa iriꞌavoniꞌuma. Rehano ubumazeꞌe sauꞌa reine, ahirizeꞌe uzaboꞌa iriꞌavoniꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo zae zamao agaḡaꞌe uzabo ga meneꞌe faine ḡianoꞌi.
Zae ahiriꞌe agaḡaniꞌa iriꞌavonadu uzabo ꞌahoga oꞌoꞌa reine, ihure agaḡaniꞌa zae rana agaruꞌeteꞌe teige, ahirize niduꞌaꞌe agaḡaniꞌa iriꞌavoniꞌuma.”
Farisea Azaḡa zu Mose Goro Ḡoeꞌa Ihozeꞌeteꞌe Azaḡa Roziro
Iesuꞌa ḡoere hauḡirotene, Farisea vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa ane teite oganoga uminiro. Ebu Iesuꞌa ani ne onamadu ogomu fataḡa uhiḡano ehoriro.
Ebu Farisea vazeḡaꞌe Iesuꞌa ꞌizema oganogano ꞌevoꞌa mene vuzuꞌiroteꞌe horonirotene zaguzagaro.
Ebu Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa Farisea vazeḡa eꞌe niro, “Farisea azaḡa, izidi zaꞌe bioze zu siuvaze enoga daꞌo vuzuꞌe deheneꞌohe. Rehano zamazeoꞌe ununu zu sauꞌaniꞌa iriꞌaveꞌohe.
Zaꞌe mene huhuzaḡa! Badiꞌaꞌa enone daꞌo mene haḡairo, rehano zama zuni haḡairo.
Eꞌanoꞌo ḡauze zahara azaḡa zenoꞌi, ꞌougine zae enone zu zama niduꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa ubumao deheḡa hune reꞌuma.

Farisea azaḡa, za aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Mazaḡa zaꞌe tirara mebaḡano eḡa zu murari teige komeꞌa fase ogomuḡa niduꞌaonoꞌo sinu gaubananao rovonadu sinu tiba ḡauḡa Badiꞌa hauꞌohe. Rehano haḡai duduḡa haḡaoga zu Badiꞌa zamare borofogaꞌe igi modeꞌohe. Za ḡau boro ꞌadiꞌe haḡaifo ebu komeꞌakomeꞌa zuni mene igi modifo.
Farisea azaḡa, zaꞌe aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Mazaḡa zaꞌe nu'onu'o neḡano vaze boroboroꞌa ehoreꞌeteꞌe habaꞌano ehoroga urateꞌohe, zu vaze ḡehaḡa habaꞌano ze zae gubazeꞌenaꞌa, zae mazao unihoga urateꞌohe.
Zaꞌe aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Mazaḡa zaꞌe rune iduḡa ꞌuꞌuruḡa heuḡa. Rune ahiꞌaꞌe idu zamaḡano ruhuḡa rehano, vazeꞌa mene ederadu eꞌe rana oname onaeꞌohe.”
Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, ḡa ꞌouge ḡoereꞌetene, emeḡe zuni rae sausaufeꞌohe.”

Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa, zae zuni aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Mazaḡa zaꞌe ihore riga hune hina vaze aduga boro ziniꞌohe, rehano zae ꞌevore huduꞌa tiba hina zu mene hune danazeꞌohe.
Zaꞌe aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Mazaḡa vouḡazeꞌa ibite zimiroteꞌe peroveta azaḡa rune iduḡa zaeꞌa ogoruꞌohe.
Vouḡazeꞌa peroveta azaḡa zimiro ebu zaeꞌa iduze ogoruꞌohe. ꞌOugadu za vouḡazeꞌa haḡai duduḡa haḡairo rae fureneꞌohe zu ihozeꞌohe.
Eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌa huhuzaḡaniꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, 'Eḡeꞌa peroveta azaḡa zu apostolo azaḡa nu zeḡe mazao tuḡuziꞌuma, rehano ze nuꞌe zimiꞌuma zu nuꞌe sausauziꞌuma.'
Badiꞌaꞌa raha ꞌadi haḡairoteꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo peroveta azaḡa zimiro. Eꞌanoꞌo eꞌe aduga niduꞌaꞌe izidi eganiꞌa odohiꞌuma.

Ze ibite Abela mau runiroteꞌeanoꞌo onao ḡonagano Zekaria maro. Zekariaꞌe dibuꞌo fataḡa zu kuru neḡano Haba Zaḡoḡa boꞌaḡano mau runiro. Oꞌe, eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, eꞌe aduga niduꞌaꞌe izidi eganiꞌa odohiꞌuma.

Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa, zaꞌe aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Mazaḡa Badiꞌa edereꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa ibihetaḡa vavaꞌeꞌeteꞌe kiḡaꞌe zaeꞌa meiniro. Rehano za mene diuḡiro ebu diuḡihi raꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zuni zaeꞌa garariro.”
Iesuꞌe ḡoere hauḡadu ne beꞌanoꞌo buarotene, Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu Farisea azaḡaniꞌa ani riḡa agiroharo ebu ḡadimu ḡehaḡa hina aduaduniro.
Mazaḡa Iesuꞌa ḡoere nu rae veꞌonine, ani obone tihi rae reiro.
